subject: MedFen private expansion: isolation clusters, term change and timeline
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@medfen.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal & capacity: MedFen private expansion request

Hi Marcus,

As we approach renewal (Dec 15), the product and infra teams are requesting an expanded private footprint. Current ask: a fully isolated VPC (US-East) with two additional inference clusters (gpu-accelerated) and a staging cluster for QA.

Key constraints:
- Isolation from other tenants (network + audit logs)
- SOC2 evidence for the new environment
- Pin model versions to a stable build for the next 12 months
- Expected 95th pct token throughput to increase by ~3.5x (see attached current_usage_report.pdf)

Can you send an options matrix (new private environment vs VPC carve-out), rough delta in ARR, and a target provisioning timeline? Also looping in Tom from procurement for budget planning.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Platform Engineering
MedFen Health

---
Attachment: current_usage_report.pdf (1.2MB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@medfen.com>
Cc: Tom Baxter <tbaxter@medfen.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity: MedFen private expansion request

Elena —

Thanks for the clear ask and the usage doc. High level we can approach this two ways:

Option A — New Private Environment (recommended for strict isolation):
- Dedicated VPC, customer-managed access controls, separate control plane instance
- 3 clusters (2 prod inference, 1 staging) with GPU pools sized to your 95th pct demand
- SLA + SOC2 evidence for new environment; additional onboarding audit window
- Estimated timeline: 6–8 weeks for provision + validation
- Estimated delta ARR: $235k–$310k annual (depending on GPU size/commit)

Option B — VPC Carve (faster, lower cost):
- Carved tenancy inside our managed VPC with isolated routing and tenant-level audits
- 3 clusters but shared control plane; slightly lower isolation guarantees
- Estimated timeline: 3–4 weeks
- Estimated delta ARR: $145k–$190k annual

Questions to narrow down the quote:
1) Do you require on-prem or is cloud-hosted in us-east sufficient?
2) Target peak tokens/sec or RPS metric for the new clusters (helps sizing)
3) Any contractual term change preferences (12 vs 24 months) — pinning model versions costs are tied to term length

I attached an initial_capacity_estimate.xlsx with a couple sizing scenarios. Happy to hop on a short call this week to walk the options.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Cloud-hosted in us-east is fine. A few clarifications:
- Target: sustained ~6.5k tokens/sec at 95th pct across production clusters; bursting to 9k for short windows.
- We need SOC2 evidence for the new environment before cutover.
- We'd prefer a 24-month term if you can provide a pricing concession; helps our amortization.
- Procurement needs to see a redline-ready SOW and an estimate for an accelerated provisioning add-on (if we pay a one-time premium to shorten timeline).

Can you also confirm whether we can pin to a specific model artifact hash and whether model updates are opt-in?

Thanks,
Elena

Marcus / Sofia —

Summary based on requirements (isolation + SOC2 evidence + 3 clusters + staging):
- Provisioning timeline (base): 6 weeks from signed SOW to validated prod cutover.
  - Week 1–2: VPC & network build, KMS/HSM integrations, IAM scoping
  - Week 3–4: Cluster provisioning (GPU pools), kernel tuning, telemetry hooks
  - Week 5: Staging validation + perf tests (we'll need MedFen test vectors)
  - Week 6: Rollout window + SOC2 evidence collection (docs & logs)
- Resource needs: 3 dedicated infra engineers (2 weeks on provisioning), 1 SE for staging validation (estimated 40 hours).
- Accelerated option: 3–4 week turnaround with premium resourcing (+35% one-time fee to cover weekend staffing & parallel ops).
- Cost delta (ballpark)
  - New Private Environment: $265,000 ARR (mid), includes dedicated control-plane ops and audit window
  - VPC Carve: $165,000 ARR (mid)
  - Accelerated provisioning fee: $92,500 one-time (estimated)

Attachments: se_provisioning_runbook.md (internal runbook with gating items).

Notes:
- For SOC2 sample artifacts we can provide audit logs and a runbook snapshot, but full audit can require an external auditor schedule (we typically provide the evidence package within the 6-week window).
- Pinning model artifacts: yes — we can pin to an immutable model artifact hash and make updates opt-in per your release cadence. This can be captured in the SOW.

If this looks reasonable I can draft an SOW and a short pricing spreadsheet to hand to procurement.

-kim
